svg.text: Cursor: on/off for every open graph (also C). Lit teal while on.
Cursor Settings: choose which fields the box shows and in what order.
Highlight (H): thickens the curve under the mouse and dims the others.
Pin (P): freezes the box in place; drag the box to move it.
Cursor Box: the nearest real sample of the nearest curve (curve name, X, Y, ...).
